messages:
Mira: Sharing the consolidated company-level goals for FY26 Q2. I pulled together inputs from product, eng, sales, and finance. Please read and react by EOD Thu. Key ask: we need to lock scope so teams can finalize roadmaps.

Mira: Link to doc: https://redwood.company/s/okrs/q2-fy26-goals (summary below).

Mira: TL;DR proposed focus areas:
- Predictable inference economics (cost per 1M tokens)
- Latency SLOs for hosted API (p95 <= 120ms)
- Enterprise readiness (SAML, Audit logs, SOC-type controls)
- Launch criteria for Redwood Dedicated pilot (2 customers, 99.9% uptime)

Mira: Draft objective + key results (short):
O: Make inference predictable & low-cost for product teams
KR1: 20% reduction in cost per 1M tokens vs baseline
KR2: p95 latency <= 120ms for 90% of routes
KR3: 2 Dedicated pilot customers onboarded with enterprise checklist passed

Sam: Quick question — are KR2 targets for hosted only or also Dedicated?

Mira: Good call. KR2 applies to hosted & dedicated public routes. For private deployments we’ll add separate SLAs.

Robin: From sales: enterprise customers are pushing for SAML + audit streaming ASAP. If we deprioritize those we risk losing 2 pipeline deals (>$1.5M).

Taylor: Finance note — the revenue risk Robin flags is real. If we push SAML into Q3 we need to quantify churn/overtime delta. Also KR1 (cost reduction) helps gross margins, but it’s not revenue in the quarter.

Sam: Engineering constraints: to get p95 to 120ms at scale we need KV cache improvements + a batching optimizer. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for infra work + 2 sprints for canary/testing. If we also do SAML + audit logs that’s another 4 engineer-sprints (security + infra).

Mira: We need a tradeoff. Option A = prioritize latency & cost (KR1+KR2) this quarter and push SAML to Q3. Option B = split team: one pod does enterprise auth, other does infra improvements, but risk missing the KR1 cost target.

Alex: My preference is a split but with a hard guardrail: Dedicated pilot onboarding must not slip. Can we scope SAML MVP to basic SSO + SCIM only? Full audit streaming can be second half.

Robin: SCIM + SSO MVP is acceptable for 3 of the 4 pipeline customers. One requires full audit exports. Can we agree on a timeline for audit exports?

Sam: If we do SSO+SCIM only, audit exports timeline moves to late Q2/early Q3. That reduces immediate eng load.

Taylor: Proposed prioritization (from finance):
- Critical this quarter: Dedicated pilot completion (revenue visibility)
- High: cost reductions (KR1) — improves margin metrics
- Medium: full audit exports (can be Q3)

Mira: Updated launch guardrails (please review):
```
- Dedicated pilot criteria:
  - 2 enterprise customers onboarded and using Dedicated for >= 2 weeks
  - Basic SSO (SAML) + SCIM implemented for pilot customers
  - Route latency SLOs met for pilot traffic (p95 <= 150ms for Dedicated during trial)
  - Security checklist signed off by Security & Sales Eng
```

Mira: If everyone is ok with those guardrails I’ll update the main doc and call the OKR draft 'locked for engineering planning'.

Robin: I can accept those guardrails if we commit to audit export roadmap milestone (date: 2026-07-15). Sales will communicate that timeline to the customer that needs full export.

Sam: Ack — engineering can commit to the guardrails and the Q3 audit export milestone, assuming we get two FTEs for Dedicated work for the quarter.

Taylor: Finance will model run-rate under Option B (split team) vs Option A and share numbers by EOD Wed.

Alex: Action items:
- Mira: update doc + add final KRs with guardrails (due EOD Thu)
- Sam: confirm eng resourcing (due Mon)
- Robin: align with customer expectations on audit export timeline (due Mon)
- Taylor: revenue/margin impact model (due Wed)

Kirby-bot: Created checklist: "dedicated-pilot-onboarding" (https://redwood.company/checklists/dedicated-pilot-onboarding).

Mira: Please react with :thumbsup: if you approve this compromise (split + guardrails), or :thumbsdown: if not. I’ll take silence as approval by EOD Thu.

Robin: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Taylor: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Kirby-bot: :white_check_mark: checklist created

Mira: Thanks — I’ll lock the draft and push to the roadmap. Follow-ups in separate threads for detailed ticketing.
